title: Decide whether [evidence.commands] may run at absorption decision time, not only close-out
body: runconfig's Evidence.Commands comment says a command defined there 'may run ONLY during close-out — never by an implementer, a per-tick verifier, a post-wave gate, or final-review tests'. npq's oracle now resolves an [evidence.acceptance] binding through BOTH [testing.commands] and [evidence.commands] and runs it mid-run, at collect, because the absorption decides what the close-out may assert. Either the comment narrows to admit the absorption decision, or the oracle should be restricted to [testing.commands] bindings only; as it stands the code and the config's own documentation disagree about one authorization.
